meta.title: Motives and periods
meta.summary: Compute three kinds of period and see the motive behind each: 2πi from the Tate motive in h(P¹) = 𝟏 ⊕ 𝟏(−1), ζ(3) and multiple zeta values as iterated integrals, and the residues of Feynman wheel graphs, 6ζ(3) for K₄.
meta.question: Are residues of Feynman integrals periods of mixed Tate motives?

examples.title: 2πi, the period of the Tate motive
